description: This file defines the SNApplicationGroup class, which manages application groups, descriptors, and related events within a device context. It handles initialization, deinitialization, descriptor management, and application lifecycle events.

classes.name: SNApplicationGroup
classes.description: A class managing application groups, including descriptor records, application lifecycle, and event notifications within a device context.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Performs cleanup and deinitialization of the application group and its device.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the application group with a callback, setting up descriptors and primary application.

methods.name: createNewDescriptorRecord
methods.description: Creates a new descriptor record with a default 'standardnotes' identifier.

methods.name: getDescriptors
methods.description: Returns all descriptors in the current record.

methods.name: findPrimaryDescriptor
methods.description: Finds and returns the primary descriptor.

methods.name: signOutAllWorkspaces
methods.description: Signs out the user from all workspaces.

methods.name: onApplicationDeinit
methods.description: Callback invoked when an application deinitializes, handling cleanup and device reset.

methods.name: setDescriptorAsPrimary
methods.description: Sets a given descriptor as the primary descriptor.

methods.name: persistDescriptors
methods.description: Persists the current descriptor record to storage.

methods.name: removeDescriptor
methods.description: Removes a specified descriptor from the record.

methods.name: removeAllDescriptors
methods.description: Removes all descriptors from the record.

methods.name: descriptorForApplication
methods.description: Retrieves the descriptor associated with a given application.

methods.name: createNewApplicationDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a new application descriptor with a unique UUID.

methods.name: createNewPrimaryDescriptor
methods.description: Creates and sets a new primary descriptor.

methods.name: unloadCurrentAndCreateNewDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a new primary descriptor and deinitializes the current primary application.

methods.name: unloadCurrentAndActivateDescriptor
methods.description: Activates a given descriptor as primary and deinitializes the current primary application.

methods.name: buildApplication
methods.description: Builds an application instance from a descriptor using the callback.
